backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor handling user profiles with access control and managing enquiries with admin-only view and answer marking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to files, components, and test IDs for deployment, URL updates, OG metadata, and indexing.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Precomputed summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose, including components, hooks, styles, and deployment-related utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md: Documentation file storing the current live deployment URL, deprecated URL, and update instructions.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md: Auto-updated record of the latest deployment date and generated public URL with verification steps.
frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md: Guide for setting up Google Search Console and sitemap submission using the generated deployment URL.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme configuration defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, Google verification tag, OG/Twitter tags, and font includes.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing full crawling and referencing a relative sitemap path.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Minimal sitemap listing the root URL with last modified date and crawl directives.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component toggling between home sections and the enquiries view, initializing runtime metadata and rendering header/footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer with branding, contact links, quick navigation, and scroll-to-section logic depending on current view.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with logo, navigation links, mobile menu, and scroll-to-section handling that resets to the home view when needed.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section showing service highlights using cards and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section providing enquiry form submission with validation and API mutation along with static contact info.
frontend/src/components/sections/Coverag: Coverage section describing primary and extended regions along with related benefits using cards and badges.
frontend/src/components/sections/Enquiri: Admin-only enquiries management view handling login, permission checks, listing enquiries, and marking them answered.
frontend/src/components/sections/FaqSect: Displays a list of FAQ items using an accordion component.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero banner with intro text, CTAs, stats, and a featured image for the homepage.
frontend/src/components/sections/Process: Shows a 5-step admissions counselling process with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Renders cards describing the main counselling services offered.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Displays student testimonials with ratings and quotes.
frontend/src/constants/contact.ts: Exports shared constants for contact phone and email details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides React Query hooks to check if the caller is admin and to fetch the caller's user role using the actor and identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider for managing authentication, identity loading, and login state using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching enquiries and performing create and mark-answered mutations through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base, component, and utility layers with extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app by rendering React with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts: Updates the og:url meta tag at runtime based on the current window origin.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from query strings, hashes, and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Describes project state, known issues, requirements, and pending features related to redeploying and documenting a new ICP0 public URL.
